research.name: Joly UI
research.note: A copy-paste shadcn/ui registry of about 40 React components, mostly buttons, inputs and text animations.
unverified: The Liquid Metal Button page references the @paper-design/shaders package, so the shader effect appears to come from that package rather than from this project; the headless screenshot showed a dark metallic pill button but not the animation.
The Image Sphere page rendered only a few scattered avatars in the headless screenshot, so the 3D rotating sphere itself was not seen.
